libGL.so.1.handling: Provide only through a validated Weston or GL4ES graphics runtime; never alias PowerVR GLES as desktop GL.

libXxf86vm.so.1.handling: Provide with the validated Weston X11 runtime used by the owning port.

libcrypto.so.1.1.handling: Keep the EOL OpenSSL 1.1 ABI private to the owning port or runtime; do not publish it in the common adapter path.

libjawt.so.handling: Resolve from the exact Java runtime mounted by the port.

libreadline.so.7.handling: Build pinned GNU Readline 7 and publish its real SONAME through the owned PortMaster runtime.

librga.so.2.handling: Reject this Rockchip-specific binary path on Allwinner V90S; do not package a fake or foreign RGA library.

libsndio.so.7.0.handling: Resolve from the owning Weston or Java runtime and validate its audio route separately.

libssl.so.1.1.handling: Keep the EOL OpenSSL 1.1 ABI private to the owning port or runtime; do not publish it in the common adapter path.
